verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is a hosted agent service, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The OpenAPI file at docs.x.ai/openapi.json does exist, but a runtime check shows it describes xAI's model REST API (api.x.ai), a different product, and contains zero Grok Bot paths. No public Grok Bot API was found anywhere in its docs; the product is driven only through its own apps, so there is no Grok Bot spec to download.
